items.quote: And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh: and the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go out of his land.
items.claim: Moses and Aaron performed wonders before Pharaoh; the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart to prevent the Israelites from leaving his land
items.action: did wonders, hardened heart, would not let go
items.object: wonders, Pharaoh's heart, children of Israel, land
